hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock launches that charges a fixed per-pool swap fee (0–5%, set at launch and immutable) split 80% creator / 5% bid wall / 15% platform. It maintains a single-sided "bid wall" liquidity range just below spot price using accumulated wall fees, and locks out external liquidity providers until pool graduation.
